Penguin body measurements

Source: R/data.R
penguin_data.Rd

Prepared measurements for 344 penguins from the Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica. Intended for comparing body mass and flipper length among species and between sexes.

Usage

penguin_data

Format

A data frame with 344 rows and 5 variables:

species

Penguin species: Adelie, Chinstrap, or Gentoo.

island

Island where the penguin was observed.

sex

Recorded sex: Male or Female. Unknown values are NA.

flipper_length_mm

Flipper length in millimetres.

body_mass_g

Body mass in grams.

Source

Palmer Station LTER and Kristen Gorman, via the palmerpenguins package. https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/

Details

Missing values are retained. Analyses should explicitly report which observations are excluded because of missing measurements or unknown sex.

Prepared using the script in data-raw/prepare_penguins.R. The source data are distributed under CC0.

Examples

head(penguin_data)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   species island    sex    flipper_length_mm body_mass_g
#>   <chr>   <chr>     <chr>              <dbl>       <dbl>
#> 1 Adelie  Torgersen Male                 181        3750
#> 2 Adelie  Torgersen Female               186        3800
#> 3 Adelie  Torgersen Female               195        3250
#> 4 Adelie  Torgersen NA                    NA          NA
#> 5 Adelie  Torgersen Female               193        3450
#> 6 Adelie  Torgersen Male                 190        3650
table(penguin_data$species)
#> 
#>    Adelie Chinstrap    Gentoo 
#>       152        68       124
